board: Adafruit I2C Stemma QT Rotary Encoder Breakout with NeoPixel (product 4991, ATSAMD09 seesaw)
reason: Check passed on ESP32 and Pico on the first run. The part is modelled as seesaw over I2C with 16-bit base/function addressing: ENCODER 0x11/0x30 returns the signed 32-bit position, GPIO_BULK 0x01/0x04 bit 24 is the switch (active low) and HW_ID reads 0x55. The header order VIN, 3Vo, GND, SCL, SDA, INT was taken from Adafruit's EAGLE board file.
